assignments.why: Shape A, managed-identity backends (docs/PILOT.md C-8): the gateway policy's authentication-managed-identity takes a token for the resource in the backend descriptor (https://cognitiveservices.azure.com for Foundry) and calls the account's /anthropic endpoint, so APIM's system-assigned identity needs Cognitive Services User on each such backend's Foundry account; D3 makes one assignment per managed-identity backend. Shape B (second-tenant backends) needs none here: the backend tenant's app registration holds its role in that tenant. The gateway's other dependencies are not Azure RBAC: the resolver admits APIM's identity through App Service Authentication (WP-RES, D2 resolver-auth) and diagnostics are WP-TEL's.
